ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Cream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Fits my recent Clapton and Hendrix interest, but I would choose a newer album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Super Session; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-oriented guitar music appeals to me, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Fool To Care; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Having recently explored Memphis, I would try more Boz Scaggs for a similar soulful sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: The River & The Thread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots-oriented sound could suit my interest in Blown Away, but I am choosing blues and soul today.
ItemID: NA; Title: In-A-Gadda-Da-Vida; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Extended heavy psychedelic rock is less appealing to me right now than the bluesier side of my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Old Sock makes more Clapton an easy choice, and the relaxed blues sound is especially appealing today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mad Dogs & Englishmen - Joe Cocker; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The soulful rock sound fits, but I would save this live album for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Live at The Old Quarter, Houston, Texas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A stripped-down live singer-songwriter album is not what I am looking for today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nothing Has Changed; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for blues and roots music right now, so a Bowie collection does not draw me in.
ItemID: NA; Title: Enigmatic Ocean; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Instrumental jazz fusion feels too far from the vocal blues and roots albums I currently want.
